verdict.rationale: The official README documents an install-scope table. Project scope is the default and writes to `./<agent>/skills/`, "Committed with your project, shared with team." Global scope via `-g` writes to `~/<agent>/skills/`, "Available across all projects," and a CI example shows `-g` used non-interactively. A `skills-lock.json` restore path (`skills install` with no args) further supports project-committed workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that both scopes behave as documented.
